title: British Championships
text:
Congratulations to our Mini relay team - Ben, Theo & Barney - for yet again winning the Bronze medal in a major event, this time at the British Championships on Brown Clee over the weekend. The double success of the team has been the subject of an article in the EADT.

A summary of SuffOC results for both the individual and the relay events at the BOC can be found here and the full results can be accessed from the SI Results webpage.
